program.name: Iron Yoga
program.subject: Strength & stretch
program.blurb: Heavy-ish lifting and a yoga flow in one session: iron first, salutations and standing poses after, or the other way round.
program.about: Lifting and yoga in one session, so strength and range of motion improve together. Upper and lower days lift first and close with a yoga flow, standing poses on the upper day and hips and backbends on the lower. The middle day opens with sun salutations and warriors, then lifts, then finishes with abs. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps. Every yoga hold gets longer at the higher levels, and one Start runs each flow.
program.split: Lift & flow / salutations, lift & abs / lower & hips
program.gear: A sturdy chair or couch for step-ups and hip thrusts.
